configuration: SpeechLess six-module implementation with per-user spatial memory, low-confidence verification, and Full/Partial/Zero input modes.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Observed context and user-supplied information enter episodic storage.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Low-confidence proposed responses trigger targeted acquisition of user confirmation or correction.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Stored spatial priors refine interpretation of current under-specified user input, beyond answer composition.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Generated responses are retained with queries and contextual sketches.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Assistant responses persist in per-user memory for subsequent recall.
record.quote: Each entry binds the query, its response

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: Verification gates storage, but retention of feedback or an associated outcome is unspecified.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Response-specific verification checks assistance and controls memory admission.
attribution.quote: A low-confidence response triggers a user correction/verification rather than being silently recorded

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Memory-content updates do not revise mechanisms; RL/SFT personalization remains future work.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Reported runs reuse memories; no run under a service-revised mechanism is stated.

notes: Text-only review of the named implementation; research scoring and diaries are excluded as service feedback.
